title: Act Floor Customizer
description:
[h1]Act Floor Customizer[/h1]
Add 0-30 extra floors to Acts 1, 2 and 3, configured in-game through BaseLib's mod config page.

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]A separate setting for each act, 0-30 each. 0 keeps the vanilla length.
[*]Question marks, shops, rest sites and elites scale with the longer map, and the normal combat pool grows with it.
[*]The map keeps the vanilla row spacing and is stretched vertically, so rooms no longer sit on top of each other. The parchment background grows with it.
[*]English and Chinese UI, following the game language. The mod name in the mod list does the same.
[*]Co-op: the host's three values apply to everyone, and other players' own numbers are ignored.
[*]One extra row of treasure rooms every N rows (default 7, 0 disables), counted from the vanilla treasure row, so a longer act also gets more chests.
[*]The treasure-map act and the golden-compass map now follow the configured length instead of staying at vanilla size.
[/list]

[h2]Install[/h2]
Subscribe to this mod and to the required [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3737335127]BaseLib[/url]. Enable both in the mod list and restart the game.

[h2]Configure[/h2]
Main menu -> BaseLib's mod config page -> Act Floor Customizer. The three sliders are Acts 1, 2 and 3. Changes apply to your next run; a run that already started keeps its map. The fourth slider sets the treasure-row spacing; the same value can be set in settings.cfg as TreasureEveryRows.

[h2]Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*]In co-op the host sends its three values when the run starts and clients ignore their own numbers. Changing numbers mid-run only affects the next run.
[*]Together with mods that enumerate every route (map enhancement mods), keep each act at 15 floors or below. A 46-row map has about 50 million routes and stalls the route analysis.
[*]Blitz mode is not supported.
[*]Other mods that rewrite combat pools or the map structure may conflict; test before relying on it.
[/list]
changeNote: 0.7.2: bonus treasure rows every 7 rows (configurable), the treasure-map act and the golden-compass map now follow the configured length, and the parchment only stretches its flat middle so the rolled ends keep their normal size.
